en: A vintage black and white postcard showing a street with uniform late 19th or early 20th-century European townhouses. The street is labeled 'Fabrikstrasse' and is sparsely populated, with a few people walking and a cyclist visible. A corner shop with German text on the signage is also visible. In the distance, an industrial smokestack rises above the buildings, emphasizing the street's industrial character.
